newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Beef market seen topping last week and packers lowering bids for live.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady. Index slightly lower but lower corn futures call supportive.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Hot, humid weather seen cutting hog movement, Cold Storage little constructive.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.30 cent. Cold Storage bullish and product markeet firm.
